title: host.update
description: This method allows to update existing hosts.

hostid.description: ID of the host to update.

inventory_mode.description: Host inventory population mode. Possible values are: -1 - disabled; 0 - manual; 1 - automatic.

ipmi_authtype.description: IPMI authentication algorithm. Possible values are: -1 - default; 0 - none; 1 - MD2; 2 - MD5; 4 - straight; 5 - OEM; 6 - RMCP+.

ipmi_privilege.description: IPMI privilege level. Possible values are: 1 - callback; 2 - user; 3 - operator; 4 - admin; 5 - OEM.

proxy_hostid.description: ID of the proxy that is used to monitor the host.

status.description: Status and function of the host. Possible values are: 0 - monitored host; 1 - unmonitored host.

tls_connect.description: Connections to host. Possible values are: 1 - No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate.

tls_accept.description: Connections from host. Possible bitmap values are: 1 - No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate. This is a bitmask field; any sum of possible bitmap values is acceptable (for example, 6 for PSK and certificate).

tls_psk_identity.description: (write-only) PSK identity; must be paired with only one PSK (across autoregistration, hosts, and proxies). Required if either tls_connect or tls_accept has PSK enabled. Do not include sensitive information in the PSK identity, as it is sent unencrypted over the network to inform the receiver which PSK to use.

tls_psk.description: (write-only) Pre-shared key (PSK); must be at least 32 hex digits. Required if either tls_connect or tls_accept has PSK enabled.

groups.description: Host groups to replace the current host groups the host belongs to. The host groups must have the groupid property defined.

interfaceid.description: ID of the interface (required to update an existing interface).

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface. Can be empty if the connection is made via IP.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface. Can be empty if the connection is made via DNS.

main.description: Whether the interface is used as default on the host. Possible values are: 0 - not default; 1 - default.

port.description: Port number used by the interface. Can contain user macros.

type.description: Interface type. Possible values are: 1 - agent; 2 - SNMP; 3 - IPMI; 4 - JMX.

useip.description: Whether the connection should be made via IP. Possible values are: 0 - connect using host DNS name; 1 - connect using host IP address for this host interface.

details.description: Additional object for interface. Required if interface type is SNMP.

version.description: SNMP interface version. Possible values are: 1 - SNMPv1; 2 - SNMPv2c; 3 - SNMPv3

bulk.description: Whether to use bulk SNMP requests. Possible values are: 0 - don't use bulk requests; 1 - use bulk requests.

community.description: SNMP community (required). Used only by SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 interfaces.

securityname.description: SNMPv3 security name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

securitylevel.description: SNMPv3 security level. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - noAuthNoPriv; 1 - authNoPriv; 2 - authPriv.

authpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 authentication passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

privpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 privacy passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

authprotocol.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - MD5; 1 - SHA1; 2 - SHA224; 3 - SHA256; 4 - SHA384; 5 - SHA512.

privprotocol.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - DES; 1 - AES128; 2 - AES192; 3 - AES256; 4 - AES192C; 5 - AES256C.

contextname.description: SNMPv3 context name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

interfaces.description: Interfaces to replace the current host interfaces.

tags.description: Host tags to replace the current host tags.

templates.description: Templates to replace the currently linked templates. The templates must have the templateid property defined.

templates_clear.description: Templates to unlink and clear from the host. The templates must have the templateid property defined.

hostmacroid.description: ID of the macro (required to update an existing macro).

type.description: Type of macro. Possible values: 0 - Text macro; 1 - Secret macro; 2 - Vault secret.

macros.description: User macros to replace the current user macros on the host.

inventory.description: Host inventory properties to replace the current host inventory properties.

date_hw_decomm.description: HW decommissioning date. Maximum length: 64 characters.

date_hw_expiry.description: HW maintenance expiry date. Maximum length: 64 characters.

date_hw_install.description: HW installation date. Maximum length: 64 characters.

date_hw_purchase.description: HW purchase date. Maximum length: 64 characters.

host_netmask.description: Host subnet mask. Maximum length: 39 characters.

macaddress_a.description: MAC address A. Maximum length: 64 characters.

macaddress_b.description: MAC address B. Maximum length: 64 characters.

oob_ip.description: OOB IP address. Maximum length: 39 characters.

oob_netmask.description: OOB host subnet mask. Maximum length: 39 characters.

os_full.description: Detailed OS name. Maximum length: 255 characters.

os_short.description: Short OS name. Maximum length: 128 characters.

poc_1_cell.description: Primary POC mobile number. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_1_name.description: Primary POC name. Maximum length: 128 characters.

poc_1_phone_a.description: Primary POC phone A. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_1_phone_b.description: Primary POC phone B. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_1_screen.description: Primary POC screen name. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_2_cell.description: Secondary POC mobile number. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_2_email.description: Secondary POC email. Maximum length: 128 characters.

poc_2_name.description: Secondary POC name. Maximum length: 128 characters.

poc_2_phone_a.description: Secondary POC phone A. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_2_phone_b.description: Secondary POC phone B. Maximum length: 64 characters.

poc_2_screen.description: Secondary POC screen name. Maximum length: 64 characters.

serialno_a.description: Serial number A. Maximum length: 64 characters.

serialno_b.description: Serial number B. Maximum length: 64 characters.

site_address_a.description: Site address A. Maximum length: 128 characters.

site_address_b.description: Site address B. Maximum length: 128 characters.

site_address_c.description: Site address C. Maximum length: 128 characters.

site_rack.description: Site rack location. Maximum length: 128 characters.

site_zip.description: Site ZIP/postal code. Maximum length: 64 characters.

software_app_a.description: Software application A. Maximum length: 64 characters.

software_app_b.description: Software application B. Maximum length: 64 characters.

software_app_c.description: Software application C. Maximum length: 64 characters.

software_app_d.description: Software application D. Maximum length: 64 characters.

software_app_e.description: Software application E. Maximum length: 64 characters.
